request.query: Collecting a multivariate polynomial by powers of one distinguished variable preserves the coefficients of each monomial

items.name: MvPolynomial.toMvPowerSeries
items.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {R : Type u_2} → [inst : CommSemiring R] → MvPolynomial σ R → MvPowerSeries σ R

items.name: MvPolynomial.coeff_X_mul
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (m : σ →₀ ℕ) (s : σ) (p : MvPolynomial σ R),
  MvPolynomial.coeff (Finsupp.single s 1 + m) (MvPolynomial.X s * p) = MvPolynomial.coeff m p

items.name: MvPolynomial.coeffs
items.type: {R : Type u} → {σ : Type u_1} → [inst : CommSemiring R] → MvPolynomial σ R → Finset R

items.name: MvPolynomial.coeffs_X_mul
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (p : MvPolynomial σ R) (n : σ),
  (MvPolynomial.X n * p).coeffs = p.coeffs

items.name: MvPolynomial.coe_monomial
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] (n : σ →₀ ℕ) (a : R),
  ↑((MvPolynomial.monomial n) a) = (MvPowerSeries.monomial n) a

items.name: MvPolynomial.coeff_mul_X
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (m : σ →₀ ℕ) (s : σ) (p : MvPolynomial σ R),
  MvPolynomial.coeff (m + Finsupp.single s 1) (p * MvPolynomial.X s) = MvPolynomial.coeff m p

items.name: MvPolynomial.coeff
items.type: {R : Type u} → {σ : Type u_1} → [inst : CommSemiring R] → (σ →₀ ℕ) → MvPolynomial σ R → R

items.name: MvPolynomial.coeToMvPowerSeries
items.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {R : Type u_2} → [inst : CommSemiring R] → Coe (MvPolynomial σ R) (MvPowerSeries σ R)
